_description: HomeParty brings fun party games together: Silent Word, Taboo, Spy, Wheel Challenge, Who Am I and more.
hero_title:
HomeParty
Party Games For Friends At Home
hero_lead: HomeParty is a multi-game party app for hangouts, house parties, birthdays, and team fun. It helps groups start playing quickly.
games_desc: Each card includes cover image, game title, and short gameplay summary.
g_funSeries_d: A 7-round party marathon: voting, drawing, word bomb, taboo, truth or dare, silent word, and who am I.
g_silentWord_d: Act out words without speaking, and let your team guess.
g_silentCinema_d: Movie charades mode for group parties.
g_whoAmI_d: Ask yes/no questions to find your hidden identity.
g_drawChain_d: Write, draw, guess: reveal the funniest chain at the end.
g_explodingWord_d: Solve and pass before the hidden timer explodes.
g_wheelChallenge_d: Spin the wheel and complete the challenge.
g_taboo_d: Explain the main word without using forbidden words.
g_trueOrFalse_d: Write a statement and let everyone guess if it is true.
g_whosMore_d: Vote who best fits the prompt in your group.
g_hotSeat_d: Answer rapid questions and get scored by others.
g_spyfall_d: Most players know the location, one secret agent does not.
g_mostLikely_d: Classic “who is most likely to” party prompts.
how_desc: Simple flow from setup to final scores.
how_1_d: Set your player count based on selected game mode.
how_2_d: Choose the best mode for your current group mood.
how_3_d: Most modes are designed for easy hand-to-hand turns.
how_4_d: See results, votes, points, and winners automatically.
cta_desc: HomeParty is the 3rd app in the Sogepps lineup and focuses on fast, replayable group fun.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around HomeParty.
